description: This is a Java source file that defines a REST API resource for managing loan charges within a financial application, including operations like listing, retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting loan charges, as well as commands like paying, waiving, and adjusting charges.

classes.name: LoanChargesApiResource
classes.description: This class provides REST API endpoints for managing loan charges, including listing, retrieving, creating, updating, deleting charges, and executing commands like pay, waive, and adjustment. It handles HTTP requests and interacts with service layers to perform the operations.

methods.name: retrieveAllLoanCharges
methods.description: Retrieves all loan charges for a given loan, identified either by loan ID or external ID, with optional field filtering.

methods.name: retrieveTemplate
methods.description: Retrieves a template for loan charges, including default values and applicable charge options, for a specified loan.

methods.name: retrieveLoanCharge
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific loan charge by loan ID and charge ID or external IDs.

methods.name: executeLoanCharge
methods.description: Creates a new loan charge or executes a command like pay, waive, or adjustment on an existing charge, identified by ID or external ID.

methods.name: updateLoanCharge
methods.description: Updates details of an existing loan charge, only if the loan is not yet approved.

methods.name: deleteLoanCharge
methods.description: Deletes a loan charge from a loan, if the loan is not yet approved.

methods.name: handleExecuteLoanCharge
methods.description: Internal method to handle command execution (pay, waive, adjustment) for loan charges based on parameters.

methods.name: getResolvedLoanChargeId
methods.description: Resolves the internal ID of a loan charge based on external ID if necessary, throwing exception if not found.
